propositions: The retired trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with external CI ChatOps substring matcher for 'recheck', causing spurious Verified -1 workflow dispatches that cancel in-flight CI runs.
Bot reply texts embed the retired trigger word, causing the bot's own Gerrit comments to re-dispatch the CI Verified workflow.
New trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' shares no substring with any '[mapping "comment-added"]' key in gerrit_to_platform.ini.template.
Retired word triggers must post a single refusal reply after project guard and change re-anchoring, never enqueue a review, and never write a label.
All bot-posted reply texts must be scrubbed of every ini-mapped trigger word to prevent self-dispatch.
Test assertions parse the ini template at runtime to enforce substring-disjointness and validate reply text safety.
